name: Return to Jitters
summary: At Raven Hill, you bring Jitters a meal from Chef Grual. The cakes finally satisfy the hermit's desperate hunger.

sections.title: A Dubious Delicacy
sections.body: Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern, where Duskwood's lack of livestock and sea life leaves him to use what the blighted forest provides. His specialty, Dusky Crab Cakes, contain no crab meat. Instead, Grual uses gooey legs from venom web spiders that creep through the wood. He calls it resourceful cooking; delicate stomachs may disagree.

sections.title: Soothing Jitters' Nerves
sections.body: At Raven Hill, Jitters huddles in fear, unable to face whatever horrors drove him from the woods. Terror keeps him from hunting or foraging, and hunger deepens his distress. The warm cakes bring a rare moment of relief to the trembling vagrant. Desperate for food, he eats without asking what kind of crab Grual used.

faq.q: What is in the Dusky Crab Cakes?
aliases: what are dusky crab cakes made of
faq.answer: Dusky Crab Cakes contain no crab. Chef Grual uses gooey legs from local venom web spiders, seasoning them to mimic traditional seafood cakes.

faq.q: Does Jitters know the cakes are made of spider goo?
aliases: does jitters know about the spiders
faq.answer: Chef Grual keeps the recipe to himself. Starved and terrified, Jitters eagerly eats the cakes without asking what is in them.

faq.q: Why couldn't Jitters get his own food?
faq.answer: Jitters is overwhelmed by fear after what he encountered in Duskwood's wild woods. Panic keeps him close to Raven Hill, where he depends on sympathetic travelers for food.
Chef Grual cooks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. With the town cut off by shadows and beasts, he uses unconventional ingredients scavengers bring him to feed the tavern's patrons.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to start jitters food quest
faq.answer: Jitters begins by asking for help with his hunger at Raven Hill in Jitters' Growling Gut. That leads you to hunt venom web spiders for Chef Grual, then return with the finished meal.
The meal satisfies Jitters' hunger, and he gives you his heartfelt gratitude. Food cannot ease his deep terror; he remains anxious and haunted by the forest's dark secrets.

angles.text: Chef Grual turns gooey venom web spider legs into palatable cakes, showing the resourcefulness cooking demands on the frontier.
Darkshire's meager, unusual diet reflects how cut off the town is from Stormwind's supplies. Locals rely on whatever creeps in the shadows.
